name: pinterest_vector_motherload
summary: Mine Pinterest for vector graphic source URLs (SVG, illustration, icon, logo, infographic). For each pin whose source_url points at fetchable vector content (github raw .svg, codepen, figma public, raw SVG endpoints), download + parse + embed every <path d='...'> via svg_vector_embed. Every harvested path becomes a crystal-anchored node in ~/.cc/svg_index.jsonl, joinable across all 5 MoE retrieval axes.

passes._note: Uses PINTREST_API key from .env. Returns pins with title/description/image_url/source_url.
Filter to URLs matching: github.com/*/raw/*.svg, codepen.io, figma.com, *.svg direct. Hand-written URL pattern matchers.
HTTPS GET each candidate, save to studio/media/Media/vectors/<pin_id>.svg. Skip non-SVG content-type responses. Throttle to respect host rate limits.
Run core/scripts/svg_harvest.sh studio/media/Media/vectors/ → ~/.cc/svg_index.jsonl. Already working on local SVGs (34 files / 32 paths smoke-tested).
Each harvested path → one InferenceRecord with tier='harvest', model='pinterest+svg_vector_embed', stores (pin_url, source_url, path_crystal, embedding) — fully joinable across 5 MoE axes.

_notes: First HARVEST workflow card. Demonstrates the chain-of-chains pattern: external content (Pinterest pins) → URL filtering → fetch → embed → crystal-anchor → join to inference chain. Three passes are ACTIVE today (harvest_pins via connector + embed_svg_paths via svg_harvest.sh). Two passes are TEXT-PLACEHOLDER (url_filter, fetch_svg_content) and need stubbed-in HTTPS client + URL pattern matchers. The link_to_crystal_chain pass requires inference_logger extension to accept tier='harvest' records. Once these three placeholders flip ACTIVE, the motherload is operational.
